title: 工厂停工与离岗
prompt: Black-and-white observational documentary footage for a serious economics explainer. Neutral grayscale silver-gelatin photography, detailed faces and material textures, soft daylight, moderate contrast, clear readable composition. Original illustrative reconstruction. Natural restrained gestures, physically coherent objects and hands. Landscape 16:9. One continuous shot, gentle camera movement only. No subtitles, no readable lettering, no logos, no watermark, no graphic overlays. Medium wide shot outside a small American factory in 1931. A foreman in a wool coat locks the factory's iron gate. Three dismissed manual workers, wearing flat caps and worn jackets, pick up their lunch pails and walk away slowly. Smoke stacks are idle. Period correct clothing and street, no modern cars. The closed gate and workers leaving are both clearly visible.
